record_identity.title: Non-consensual sexual identity synthesis from a real person’s source image

summary: A generative system transforms the image or likeness of an identifiable real person into sexualised, intimate, nude or pornographic synthetic content without that person’s consent, including transformations derived from childhood images.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: The harm is not generic adult-content generation: it is appropriation of a real person’s identity into synthetic sexual material. Consent, identity integrity, child protection and downstream persistence remain relevant even when the synthetic body or scene never existed.

failure_mode_definition: A failure occurs when a system uses a real identifiable person’s source image or likeness to generate sexualised or intimate synthetic content without valid consent. Minor-derived and adult non-consensual manifestations are subtypes of the same identity-appropriation mechanism.
failure_threshold: The threshold is met where the generated sexual or intimate representation remains recognisably attributable to a real person and no valid consent authorises the transformation, regardless of whether the generated scene depicts an event that occurred.

failure_classification.recurrence_pattern: repeatable wherever systems permit source-image sexualisation without valid consent controls
failure_classification.persistence: generated material may persist and propagate after initial creation
failure_classification.reproducibility: safety controls can be tested with consented synthetic fixtures without reproducing abusive content involving real people
failure_classification.visibility: overt in outputs but provenance and consent state may be hidden downstream
failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: S1 reflects severe identity, sexual-abuse and child-safety pathways documented in current reporting; it does not decide platform liability or disputed individual claims.
failure_classification.severity_assessment_gap: Platform liability, precise output counts and some individual allegations remain unadjudicated.
